page.overview:
Who is Theodosia?

Sister Theodosia was a talented and ambitious acolyte of the Bene Gesserit who lived in the second century AG. She harbored a dangerous secret about her past.

Theodosia was bred as an experiment by Tlulaxan geneticists and was born with the ability to transform herself into any other person.

Theodosia was training to be a Truthsayer when word spread that the princess Ynez Corrino would be arriving soon to train with them. During their training, Tula showed them a brain and asked who they thought the man had been. Theodosia said he must have been a criminal, but Jen correctly labeled him a survivor. Tula used this to talk about the signs they were learning to spot in people's bodies to know when they were lying. They were all then faced with prisoners and were tasked with determining if they were lying or not. Theodosia determined that her person's words were true, but her intent was to deceive.

When word spread that Kasha had died, Theodosia talked about it with the other acolytes and suggested it was an assassination. She suggested they all keep their guards up. Valya then came to her and said that Theodosia would be coming with her to Salusa Secundus. They made the trip and Valya told her she'd replace Kasha and make herself Ynez's new confidant. Valya took Theodosia to Ynez and introduced them, saying Theodosia would take care of her. Ynez didn't want to get to know her and said she only wanted to know how Kasha died.
